description:
Browse with clear, familiar mobile controls—and spend less time waiting on artificial page delays.

Speed Browser can independently accelerate JavaScript timeouts and intervals, animation-frame timestamps, Web and CSS animations, and audio or video playback. Give timers and animations their own multiplier from 1× to 100×, set media playback from 1× to 16×, or turn off only the types a website needs to run normally. Media rates may be limited further by the webpage or browser.

Manual mode gives you a live view of active page timers. Invoke a timer immediately, pause invocations, disable one call, block a repeating source, or hide noisy sources.

Speed Browser keeps your preferences and recent URLs on your device. It contains no ads and no third-party analytics.

Speed Browser does not speed up downloads, network requests, or browser-native work. Some websites may behave unexpectedly at high multipliers; you can always switch a type to 1×, turn it off, or disable acceleration for that site.
promotionalText: A familiar iOS browser with precise controls for skipping artificial JavaScript timer delays.
